solves.reason: 본문: 'reduce costs and promote local industries', 'environmentally sustainable', 'designs are easy to use' → reduce-sustainable-easy
본문: 'natural processes', 'gathers rainwater', 'strengths is that it is simple' → natural-gathers-simple
본문: 'construct it in just one day', 'solve local issues', 'affordable, effective, and eco-friendly' → construct-solve-affordable
본문 원문은 'strengths is that it is simple'. 'complicated'은 문맥상 반대(강점=간단함)이므로 부적절
본문 원문은 'reduce costs and promote local industries'. 'hinder'(방해하다)는 원문 'promote'(촉진하다)와 반대되어 부적절
본문 원문은 'eco-friendly materials like soil, wood, and natural fiber nets'. 흙/나무/천연섬유net은 친환경 재료이지 'toxic'(유독한)이 아니므로 부적절
원문: 'maintain the technologies without specialized training' → training
원문: 'the tower captures fog and changes it into water drops' → fog
원문: 'One of the tower's strengths is that it is simple' → strengths
utilize = 사용하다 = use
employs = 사용하다/채택하다 = uses
demonstrates = 보여주다 = shows
lack(부족) ↔ abundance(풍부)
clean(깨끗한) ↔ dirty(더러운)
(A) 탑의 가장 아래 부분(lowest part) = 맨 아랫부분, (B) 관계의 토대(foundation of relationship) = 토대 → '맨 아랫부분 - 토대'
'able to be replaced naturally so that it is never used up' = 재생 가능한 = renewable
'the tower captures fog and changes it into water drops' - captures와 병렬 구조, 3인칭 단수 현재형 changes
'by + 동명사' 구조: 'by using eco-friendly materials'
원문: 'environmentally sustainable because they rely on renewable resources' → renewable resources
원문: 'It employs natural processes to deliver 100 liters of clean water daily' → natural processes
